Welcome to Libra Guesthouse

Chiang Mai’s friendliest family run guesthouse.

Libra Guesthouse is Chiang Mai’s friendliest family-run place to stay and hang out. Once you stay with us, we consider you family. Our guesthouse is recommended by Lonely Planet, Rough Guide, and Frommer’s Travel Guides. We are also reviewed on TripAdvisor. Situated on a quiet street in the heart of the Old City, we are close to all the city’s main attractions—the perfect place from whichto explore the Old City.

We have been the accommodation of choice for travelers visiting Chiang Mai since 1987, welcoming everyone from solo travelers to families. While you’re here, we would love to sit with you and share information about our Thai and hill-tribe culture.

At the guesthouse, we provide a wide range of services and amenities:

• Free Wifi

• Free drinking water refills

• Swimming pool

• Treks and tours

• Information about Chiang Mai and nearby attractions
